translations.rendering: All things are produced by the Tao, and nourished by its outflowing operation.
Tao gave them birth; The 'power' of Tao reared them.
The way gives them life; Virtue rears them.
The Tao gives birth to all beings, nourishes them, maintains them, cares for them, comforts them, protects them.
translations.note: paraphrases de away entirely; no distinct English term is minted for it here

houseTranslation.text: De is what showing up as some definite thing, rather than remaining wholly unformed, costs and yields at once.
